name: ldg-prepare-the-sponsor-conversation
description: Prepares one page for the meeting where you say it is not only a training problem, producing the findings with their evidence, the sponsor's interest behind the request, an options table with what each needs from the sponsor, likely objections with replies, shared criteria and a blank agreement record. Use for "run ldg-prepare-the-sponsor-conversation", "is it a training problem", "stakeholder meeting", "tell the sponsor it is not training", "push back on a training request", "say no to a course", "order taker", "prepare a sponsor meeting", part of The Complete Claude Guide for L&D Pack by 90n.
